email.subject: Peak Group Fitness site on mobile
email.body:
Hi Chloe,

I checked Peak Group Fitness's site and two things stood out. It isn't optimized for mobile, which likely costs you the most signups since most people search for a gym on their phone and leave if the page doesn't work right. The footer also still shows outdated info, which can make people second-guess whether you're active.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no retainer. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you exactly what's broken and what fixing it would look like?
